items.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amidst allegations of being targeted by a Chinese spy and of having extramarital affairs.
The Salvadoran military intervention in Haiti intensifies with a strike on 400 Mawozo's alleged headquarters and a deployment to Stade Sylvio Cator.
American ocean liner SS United States is scuttled in the Gulf of Mexico to create the largest artificial reef.
The End of Everything by M. John Harrison wins the Booker Prize.
